manifest.checkpoint: minimum fixed sampled validation MMD among initial and each 25-update checkpoint; both modes same validation
manifest.exact_mode: full population Fourier MMD; ignores minibatch targets during optimization
manifest.fallback: only if gap fails: 4096 reference samples for both encoders, same data/maps/bank/optimizer; reselect exact controls with matching validation
manifest.gate: each encoder median paired mean-TVD(sampled-exact)<=.03; no unexplained estimator failure
manifest.sampled_mode: unbiased sample-pair MMD; fixed sampled nonidentity masks, fresh reference samples each update

scope: Development only; all 11 conditions used in training. No new generalization evidence.
